## What to build

go_test calls the shared helper through a prelude patch. That includes project-relative paths (hazard G1), so Go hits work across checkouts (spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An unchanged go_test is a hit on the second run
- [ ] The hit is also served in a second checkout of the same revision
- [ ] godeps integration cases actually run (the fixtures bug is fixed)
